description: The European Union formally withdrew the proposed AI Liability Directive in 2025 due to industry resistance and limited political support.

instances.assertion: The European Commission has officially withdrawn the proposed AI Liability Directive from its 2025 work program.
The European Commission withdrew the proposed AI Liability Directive in its 2025 Work Programme due to political friction and industry concerns.
The European Union formally withdrew the proposed AI Liability Directive in 2025 due to industry resistance and limited political support.
The European Union withdrew its proposed AI Liability Directive in 2025 due to industry resistance and lack of political consensus.
